title: Für Elise (theme, arranged for this app)
subtitle: A-section theme only, simplified arrangement
trains: Melodic phrasing over a broken-chord left-hand accompaniment, with a chromatic passing-tone motif.

provenance.author: Musicanyya practice material
provenance.basedOn: Beethoven, Für Elise, WoO 59 (public domain, composed c. 1810). A-section pitches and rhythm were checked against the Mutopia Project's public-domain LilyPond engraving (piece-info id 931, fur_Elise_WoO59.ly, typeset by Stelios Samelis) before this simplified transcription.
provenance.note: Theme only: the pickup and bars 1-8 of WoO 59, through the theme's first cadence on the A-minor tonic. The B and C sections of the complete piece are not included, and the ending is simplified to a single-pass cadence instead of the repeat back to bar 1.
